high_level_description: The image depicts a man dressed in traditional Middle Eastern attire. He is wearing a white dishdasha (a long, loose-fitting robe) with a dark blue inner layer. Over his head, he has a black and white keffiyeh, which is a traditional headscarf commonly worn in the region. The man also wears glasses and has a neatly trimmed beard. On his chest, there is a small pin or badge featuring an illustration of two figures, possibly representing a family or a significant symbol.
